## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Summary
Update tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh with new structural assertions that verify
SKILL.md Phase 3 Step 2b.1 writes dso.workflow instead of merge.strategy, using
GitHub remote detection. These assertions must FAIL (RED) before Task T2 updates
SKILL.md, then pass GREEN after T2.

## Implementation Steps

1. Read the existing test_onboarding_skill_has_merge_strategy_question function
   (around line 1519 in tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh).

2. Add a new test function test_onboarding_skill_writes_dso_workflow that:
   - Extracts the Step 2b.1 section from SKILL.md (use the same awk pattern
     already in test-onboarding-skill.sh)
   - Asserts the section contains 'dso.workflow' (the canonical key)
   - Asserts the section contains 'https://github.com/' (HTTPS remote detection)
   - Asserts the section contains 'git@github.com:' (SSH remote detection)
   - Asserts the section contains 'dso.workflow=ci-pr' (GitHub remote outcome)
   - Asserts the section contains 'dso.workflow=local' (non-GitHub remote outcome)
   - Asserts the section contains a skip guard phrase (already present/set/exists
     near dso.workflow — meaning: if dso.workflow already in config, skip write)
   - Asserts the section contains grammar guidance for the written value:
     no quotes around the value, bare key=value format

3. Update test_onboarding_skill_has_merge_strategy_question to NOT assert
   'merge.strategy' appears in Phase 3 Step 2b.1 (the Step 2b section).
   Instead, assert it is absent from Phase 3 Step 2b.1 (the write step no
   longer writes merge.strategy). The Phase 2 Question 11 dialog may still
   reference it as historical/superseded, so scope the assertion narrowly to
   the Step 2b.1 write instruction.

4. Call the new test function at the end of the file (before print_summary).

5. Verify the tests FAIL with the current SKILL.md (this is the RED state).

## TDD Requirement
Tests are the deliverable for this task. After writing:
- bash tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh
  Must exit non-zero (RED) because SKILL.md still has merge.strategy write.
- The new test_onboarding_skill_writes_dso_workflow function must be named
  exactly that way for the test-index fuzzy match to work.

## Pattern Reference
# from tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh:1519-1563 (existing merge.strategy test)
test_onboarding_skill_has_merge_strategy_question() {
    _snapshot_fail
    local section
    section=$(awk '/Step 2b/,/Step 2c|Step 3:|^## Phase 4/' "$SKILL_MD" 2>/dev/null)
    local has_merge_strategy="no"
    if echo "$section" | grep -q 'merge\.strategy'; then
        has_merge_strategy="yes"
    fi
    assert_eq "... (merge.strategy)" "yes" "$has_merge_strategy"
    assert_pass_if_clean "test_onboarding_skill_has_merge_strategy_question"
}

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b' || true  # Note: new tests expected to FAIL (RED) — but existing tests must still pass
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true
- [ ] New test function test_onboarding_skill_writes_dso_workflow exists in test-onboarding-skill.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_onboarding_skill_writes_dso_workflow' tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh
- [ ] New test asserts 'dso.workflow' key in SKILL.md Step 2b.1 section
  Verify: grep -A30 'test_onboarding_skill_writes_dso_workflow' tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh | grep -q 'dso\.workflow'
- [ ] New test asserts 'https://github.com/' appears in Step 2b.1 section
  Verify: grep -A30 'test_onboarding_skill_writes_dso_workflow' tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh | grep -q 'https://github\.com/'
- [ ] New test asserts 'git@github.com:' appears in Step 2b.1 section
  Verify: grep -A30 'test_onboarding_skill_writes_dso_workflow' tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh | grep -q 'git@github\.com:'
- [ ] New test is called from the bottom of the file (before print_summary)
  Verify: grep -q 'test_onboarding_skill_writes_dso_workflow$' tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh
- [ ] Running the test file exits non-zero (RED state — SKILL.md not yet updated)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh; test $? -ne 0
- [ ] .test-index NOT updated (fuzzy match works: 'onboardingskillsh' in 'testonboardingskillsh')
  Verify: grep -c 'test-onboarding-skill' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index" | grep -qE '^[0-9]'
data.title: Write failing UPDATE tests for dso.workflow remote detection in test-onboarding-skill.sh
